title: 50bb · Turn to river
description: A complete turn-to-river game on Qs 9h 6c 2d with a 32bb pot and 34bb behind. All legal river cards and both streets' modeled betting actions are solved together. Half-pot, pot, all-in, and one subsequent raise are modeled.
rangeAssumptions: A deliberately narrow illustrative turn exercise: QQ, AQ suited and missed straight draws against sets, top pair and draws. These are declared study ranges, not certified preflop ranges. Equal weight per unblocked exact combination; rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
